comparison.objective: Press two new floor tiles down flush with laid tiles; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar alignment and distributed seating force versus recessed tool use, controlled rotary adjustment, counterholding, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both tiles finish flush versus carriage stops within dynamic and retention limits. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Forceful seating to a static flush condition differs from tuning a retained damping parameter from motion response.
